connected_to: שנתקשר להצדיק האמת, והתקשרות הינו אהבת נפש מה שאוהב להצדיק מאד
assignments.reason: The expulsion of ruach shtut (לגרש מקרבו הרוח שטות) is essentially a concept belonging to the domain of the spirit of folly — it describes what is done TO the ruach shtut. Its essential nature is defined by its object: the ruach shtut that fills the heart and must be driven out. Following the precedent of הכנעת היצר הרע in Torah #1 (assigned to the evil package because it describes the evil force being overcome), this node belongs in Package 1 alongside רוח שטות and אויר, as it is the state-description of the evil spirit's expulsion. The source text opens: 'צָרִיךְ הָאָדָם לְמַהֵר מְאֹד לְגָרֵשׁ מִקִּרְבּוֹ הָרוּחַ שְׁטוּת' — the concept is inseparable from the ruach shtut itself.

This node describes the rapid expulsion of the spirit of folly (שמגרש במהירות הרוח שטות מקרבו). It is a variant of the same concept as 'לגרש מקרבו הרוח שטות' but with the added dimension of speed (מהירות). Its essential nature is still the ruach shtut domain — the act is defined by what is being expelled. The source text (paragraph 3): 'עַל יְדֵי שֶׁמְּגָרֵשׁ בִּמְהִירוּת הָרוּחַ שְׁטוּת מִקִּרְבּוֹ' — the speed itself is explained by the nature of avir (air rushing to escape through the hollow of the Tzaddik's heart), which is the physical mechanism of Package 1. The מהירות is a property of the אויר/רוח שטות, not of the person or the Tzaddik.

unassigned_nodes.node_text: שֶׁנִּתְקַשֵּׁר לְהַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת, וְהִתְקַשְּׁרוּת הַיְנוּ אַהֲבַת נֶפֶשׁ מַה שֶּׁאוֹהֵב לְהַצַּדִּיק מְאֹד
unassigned_nodes.reason: Connection to the true Tzaddik through soul-love (hitkashrut / ahavat nefesh) is a wholly good/holy concept belonging to the domain of the Tzaddik and devotion. Its essential nature is love and attachment to the Tzaddik — the positive remedy prescribed by the teaching. There is no existing bechina package in Torah #176 that corresponds to the Tzaddik/devotion domain. Package 1 (רוח שטות ואויר) is the evil domain of folly; this node's essential nature is the opposite — the holy force that combats folly. Assigning it to the evil package would violate the principle of assignment by essential nature. No suitable existing package exists.

connected_to: שנתקשר להצדיק האמת, והתקשרות הינו אהבת נפש מה שאוהב להצדיק מאד
unassigned_nodes.reason: The inclusion of one's heart within the Tzaddik's heart (נכלל לבו בלב הצדיק) is a holy concept describing mystical union with the Tzaddik's inner dimension. Its essential nature is the Tzaddik's heart — the chalal (hollow space) that serves as the receptive vessel enabling the mechanism of expulsion. While it plays a mechanistic role in the causal chain (providing the empty space for the avir to escape to), the concept itself IS about the Tzaddik's heart and the person's inclusion within it — a domain of holiness and closeness to the Tzaddik. No existing bechina package in Torah #176 matches this domain.

The broken heart (לב נשבר) is the ultimate positive outcome of the teaching — the spiritual attainment produced by the rapid expulsion of ruach shtut. Its essential nature is a state of the heart in holiness: contrition, openness, and brokenness before God. In Breslov teaching, lev nishbar is a supreme spiritual value (see Likutay Moharan I:2, etc.). It does not belong to the evil domain of ruach shtut (Package 1) because it is not about folly or air — it is about the heart achieving a holy state. No existing bechina package in Torah #176 corresponds to the heart/contrition domain.
